{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mantine Casino''' was one of the two [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] located aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']]. Located on the [[Recreation Deck]], it was the cheaper of the two casinos aboard. It offered gambling and recreational electronic amusements, including [[magna-shuffle]], [[Imperial Commander]], [[Zinbiddle/Legends|Zinbiddle]], and [[Denebian holo-chess]].
